title: Add AL fast prompt interface and wrappers
summary: A new GetFastPrompt interface and AOAI Fast Prompt Response codeunit enable AL code to fetch blob-backed prompt templates from Edge Configuration Service with typed response handling.
key_points: New GetFastPrompt public procedure on Azure OpenAI codeunit for retrieving ECS-stored prompt templates
New AOAI Fast Prompt Response codeunit (7789) provides typed response object with template, error code, and error message
Integrates with DotNet ALCopilotFunctions layer to resolve fast prompts from ECS
Supports error handling for invalid keys and unsupported authorization scenarios
AI module object ID range expanded from 7788 to 7789
